name: ConMeC v1
comment: Six metonymy types of ConMeC as coercions between sense sorts. One literal sort and one coerced sort per type, one coercion edge per type. No declared equivalences (rules) yet. Sorts and edges follow Pedinotti and Lenci (2020) as used by ConMeC.

edges.name: contents
edges.reading: the contents of the container, or an activity involving the contents

edges.name: output
edges.literal: the producer itself (a person or an organization)
edges.reading: what the producer produced (their work, music, writing or other output)

edges.name: maker
edges.literal: the product itself (a publication, programme or other product)
edges.reading: the people or organization that produce the product (its editors, authors, publisher)

edges.name: located
edges.reading: the people, institutions, activities or events located at the place

edges.name: result
edges.literal: the causer itself (an instrument, agent or thing)
edges.reading: the result or effect the causer brings about (for example the sound or music it produces)

edges.name: possessor
edges.reading: the person who possesses or uses the object
